summary: The filing is a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited preliminary Q1 2026 financial results for Prenetics Global Ltd. It reports revenue, gross profit, operating loss, and adjusted EBITDA, along with segment details for continuing operations and the IM8 brand. The press release also mentions a divestiture of digital assets for $41.3 million in proceeds and a $19 million share repurchase execution under a $40 million buyback program. However, this is a routine earnings report—not a special situation event—as it provides an operational update without announcing a new M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, or other corporate action that would warrant classification as a special situation.
